scope: Independent follow-up: actual trusted CLI parent/child authority boundary, not new functionality or independent helper capability

confirmedFacts.fact: run dispatches trust before reopening the requested Keychain. The trust operation validates input sizes/DER, same leaf/root bytes, hosted-runner facts and actual public user-trust settings/authorization. It does not independently prove that the cert belongs to this producer Keychain.

Actual parent constructs/compiles the helper in one newly created chmod0700 private temporary directory, generates the self-signed private key and public cert itself, builds one request from those bytes and random Keychain password, imports it into the temporary Keychain, verifies actual private-key challenge, partitions/inspection and fresh reopen fingerprint, then explicit codeSign policy, then invokes the same private helper/request through bounded stdin.

OwnedUserTrustScope copies that request while dropping P12 fields, requires exact same base64 leaf/root, and requires the typed child certificateSHA256 to match the captured parent leaf bytes. There is no user/network/IPC input parser or additional trust entry source in this production call path.

The helper runs as the same hosted-runner OS user and only requests the public user trust-setting authorization right through Authorization Services. It has no setuid/elevated service, sudo/admin/system authority or inherited authorization credential beyond what the OS would grant the caller via the same public APIs.

decision: No confirmed present production bug from accepting a different same-user direct helper invocation. A caller able to execute that private same-user CLI with fabricated hosted-runner facts can already request its own user trust via the same public OS authorization. Current exact-owned scope follows the source-bound controlled parent dataflow, not an unforgeable self-contained child authorization proof. Root confirmed this is the intended trusted CLI boundary and does not require a new independent helper authorization layer.
clarificationToPriorReview: References to exact owned fixture mean the actual producer-owned cert/key/request lifecycle. They must not be read as a claim that the helper alone authenticates arbitrary stdin as producer-owned identity. Independent helper reopen/challenge for arbitrary future callers was not implemented or established.
